notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_8.md CB8-B. DRAFT. Commit with q0165. Days processed in a seeded order alternating SCREEN and HOLDOUT so the ingress cap truncates both evenly; missing/corrupt hours lose the day (counted, never replaced). Stores derived states only (tens of MB at most). No wallet stored. Final stage seals the HOLDOUT root (listing sha256) after seal-time drops by id and key against every seal copy committed by then (DROPPED_* blocks). Round 1 item 3: market-days without events in 14Z-15Z are labelled 'source unavailable' (never 'no trade'). Item 4: also stores the state at t + 10 s for the latency check. IMPLEMENTED 2026-10-17 (cb8_books.books_fetch). Refuses (exit 2) unless the frame run is updown_frame_complete and every frame file matches its manifest hash. Stage order: count-only coverage audit (hour 13Z of 20 seeded days; FAIL ends 'updown_books_source_unavailable', no checkpoint extracted), then per day (seeded order alternating SCREEN/HOLDOUT) states then prints, then finalize and the HOLDOUT seal. The ingress cap (90 GB decimal, audit included) is checked before each day; later days are recorded 'ingress_cap'. States are stored at t_end - {600,300,120,60} s and +10 s each (asks_top = best 10 ask levels for the latency check). Post-t_end prints go to *_guarded files. The lookback to 14Z is per token (no book event by t_end - 600 s). FREEZE-CHECK FIXES 2026-10-17: a pmxt event clock more than 1 h outside the file's hour is HourCorrupt (day lost, counted); a market whose token has events but never a book snapshot is 'book_unavailable' (its own label with a per-state book_status column; not 'no trade', not halted; days.csv.gz n_book_unavailable); the seal's drops use seal_copy_ids_audited: only seal copies committed (identical to HEAD) by then, and unparseable / id-less / uncommitted copies are recorded with reasons in HOLDOUT_SEAL.json drops.seal_copies_skipped (used copies with sha256); pmxt bytes are metered in a finally block so failed hours count against the ingress cap; the HOLDOUT seal also covers updown_frame/holdout/ (frame_holdout/).
